name: Butter and Olive Oil Shortbread Cookies by Land O Lakes Butter®

instructions.primary_message: Using a stand mixer, beat the Land O Lakes® Butter with Olive Oil and Sea Salt and vanilla until creamed. Add sugar and mix until combined.
On low, add flour gradually until fully incorporated, scraping down the sides of the bowl one or two times during the mixing.
Shape dough into a log-shaped cylinder about 1 ½-inches thick. Wrap with plastic wrap and refrigerate until firm, about 1 hour, up to overnight.
Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Unwrap and slice dough crosswise into ⅓-inch thick slices.
Place slices on a parchment paper-lined baking sheet, about 2 inches apart. Poke a few holes with a toothpick into the top of the cookies.
Bake for 10 minutes. Remove from the oven and let cool slightly before transferring to a cooling rack.
